texts.preamble: Bal Krishna Arora vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 26 February, 2026 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Gwl:7494 1 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Gwalior
texts.facts: This revision has been filed without surrender of the petitioner. The petitioner was also directed to file copy of relevant order-sheets of the trial Court with regard to his surrender. More than two years has lapsed thereafter, but neither the petitioner has surrendered before the trial Court nor filed any document.
texts.arguments: 4 . For ready reference, Rule 48 of Chapter X of the High Court of Madhya Pradesh Rules, 2008 is reproduced as under: - "48. A memorandum of appeal or revision petition against conviction, except in cases where the sentence has been suspended by the Court below, shall contain a declaration to the effect that the convicted person is in custody or has surrendered after the conviction." 5. Hon'ble the Apex Court in the case of Daulat Singh Vs. The State of Madhya Pradesh passed in Special Leave Petition (Criminal) Diary No.20900/2024 on 30/07/2024 has elaborately dealt with similar issue and held that revision without surrender is not maintainable and no exemption can be granted.
